title: App has issues, please fix
body:
## Summary

I am encountering various issues with the application. It seems that certain functionality is not working as expected and this is causing problems for my workflow. I would appreciate it if someone could look into this and help resolve the issue.

## Description

The application should work correctly without any issues.

## Additional Context

I hope this helps. Please let me know if you need any further information. Thank you for the opportunity to report this.
